aggregation: Average paired training seeds first; equal images, then equal task pairs within image.

pure_probe_stability.scope: Descriptive two-half finite-library stability; halves are not independent image samples.

primary_probe_gap_association.predictor_scope: Label-informed pure-probe library diagnostic; not available for deployment.

held_image_prediction.baseline: Both full-model margins with symmetric quadratic terms plus angle.
held_image_prediction.prediction_uncertainty_scope: Image bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold predictions, without model refitting.
